sense.evidence: The few Aussie terms fit: "Those who were on side with his policies", "having a go at popular amusements", "ciggies".

register.evidence: A plain modernised obituary with a handful of Aussie touches, well short of a level-4 brief: "He graduated from Wesleyan in 1869 and from the Divinity School of Boston University in 1871."

tone.evidence: The measured, faintly wry obituary tone is intact: "Here, for instance, is an odd title that crops up in a long list of others that don't surprise".

flow.evidence: Reads smoothly: "He also tried to stop the Dempsey-Carpentier fight going ahead in New Jersey in the Summer of 1921."

variety.evidence: Little slang to vary; it leans on plain paraphrase.
